basins.title: Storm basins
basins.description: Choose one or more basins by storm ID prefix. AL is the Atlantic, EP is the Eastern Pacific, and CP is the Central Pacific.

includeForecastTrack.title: Include forecast track points
includeForecastTrack.description: Fetch the linked NHC forecast track and include valid time, position, maximum wind in knots, and classification for each forecast point.

minIntensity.title: Minimum storm classification
minIntensity.description: Filter by the current NHC storm classification. TD includes subtropical depressions, TS includes subtropical storms, and HU includes major hurricanes. Leave blank for all classifications.

onlyNew.title: Emit new or changed advisories only
onlyNew.description: Compare the public advisory number, issue time, and forecast track availability with the last saved dataset row for each storm under this state key.

stateKey.title: Monitoring state key
stateKey.description: Shared label for successive monitoring runs. Use 1 to 50 letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. Choose a separate key for each schedule.
